Iteration 24/25, stage appraise, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- dependency_composite: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Assess the newly delivered discovery evidence. Optionally set validate to one eligible claim reference for independent validation; omit it for no request. The controller attaches the discovery result. Validation arrives after this stage.

record.narrative: Due evidence adds no new accepted association. The signed-direction convention is retained: positive signed estimates support the registered claim direction; for direction -1 claims such as CDKN2A or PTEN loss, positive signed values correspond to a negative exposed-minus-comparator raw difference and therefore stronger dependency. H301 remains unresolved and I defer further supplied-data follow-up because the clean high-Cas9 context is imprecise and does not credibly clear the 0.15-unit threshold: signed estimate +0.083 (95% lower -0.045 to upper +0.212), with only 31 exposed observations. The point is below threshold and the lower bound crosses zero, so this does not support a meaningful CDKN2A-loss association; however, the upper bound is above threshold, so a threshold-level effect cannot be excluded in this small selected context. This refines rather than changes the overall conclusion that CDKN2A loss is suggestive/borderline but not accepted. H302 is rejected: the CDKN2A-loss-by-TP53-loss interaction estimate is signed -0.074 (95% -0.337 to +0.189), opposite to the claimed positive direction, and does not credibly support threshold-level positive effect modification in TP53-loss cells. This rejection means no meaningful positive interaction is supported; it is not proof of no interaction. H303 is unresolved and deferred: PTEN loss in squamous cells with screen_roc_auc >= 0.95 has signed estimate +0.173 (95% -0.098 to +0.444), a point above threshold but with a lower bound below zero. It neither confirms a threshold-level PTEN-loss association in this narrow high-quality squamous stratum nor excludes one. The broader PTEN-loss association remains supported from stronger and validated core analyses such as H37, H70, H149, and H177, so this context check does not overturn that broader claim. H304, H305, and H306 are rejected closed. The adenocarcinoma-versus-squamous contrast is signed -0.023 (95% -0.090 to +0.044), batch_b-versus-batch_c is +0.040 (95% -0.046 to +0.127), and 10% versus 2% serum is +0.012 (95% -0.072 to +0.095). In each case the interval lies inside the +/-0.15-unit meaningfulness band and rules out the claimed threshold-level positive difference, though these are unadjusted supplied-dataset descriptive contrasts and do not establish absence of confounding or causal structure. No independent validation is requested because remaining new validation capacity is zero. The core accepted supplied-dataset associations remain KEAP1 loss associated with weaker dependency, SMARCA4 loss with stronger dependency, TP53 loss with weaker dependency, MSI-high with stronger dependency, and PTEN loss with a moderate stronger-dependency association. CDKN2A remains the principal unresolved borderline signal. No registered interaction, including the CDKN2A-by-TP53-loss interaction, is accepted as supported effect modification. All conclusions remain associations in the supplied composite-dependency dataset only and do not establish causality, single-gene knockout mechanism, or external generalizability.

prompt:
Iteration 24/25, stage synthesize, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short

Iteration 25/25, stage explore, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.

with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.

changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.

parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.

Direction convention is as registered: for direction +1, a positive signed estimate supports weaker dependency; for direction -1, a positive signed estimate supports stronger dependency. These do not overturn the broader PTEN association but caution against treating PTEN as uniformly precise in every subgroup.\n\nCausality, mechanism, and generalizability. All conclusions are measured associations among supplied variables in a lung-lineage composite-dependency dataset. The endpoint does not represent a single gene knockout, so accepted associations for TP53 loss, KEAP1 loss, SMARCA4 loss, PTEN loss, MSI-high, or CDKN2A loss do not establish that loss of that measured feature causes the composite-score shift. Research markers and signatures are constructed assays with no assigned biological role and did not add independent signal. The validation used here is internal replication within the supplied validation framework, not external generalization. The unadjusted Welch contrasts may also be confounded by correlated mutation profiles, ploidy, MSI status, growth rate, Cas9 activity, screen-quality indicators, and batch.\n\nMost informative next analysis. If truly independent or external data become available, the highest-value next step is a small pre-specified replication of only the core set: KEAP1 loss weaker dependency, SMARCA4 loss stronger dependency, TP53 loss weaker dependency, MSI-high stronger dependency, PTEN loss stronger dependency, and CDKN2A loss stronger dependency under a clean, MSI-negative, MTAP-intact setting, tested against the same 0.15-unit threshold. If only supplied-data analysis remains feasible, the most informative next analysis is a pre-specified multivariable adjustment model including the core correlated predictors together with ploidy or aneuploidy, growth rate, Cas9 activity, screen_roc_auc, MTAP, lineage, and batch where estimable, followed by a narrow multiplicity-corrected report. Further unadjusted subgroup mining is less informative because the core signals are already established and the remaining borderline CDKN2A/PTEN context questions are better addressed by adjusted or external analysis. Experimental perturbation would be required before causal, mechanistic, therapeutic, or generalizability claims."}}

record.narrative: No assessments are due and independent validation capacity is exhausted, so this final exploration adds focused supplied-dataset comparisons intended to resolve the remaining ambiguity around CDKN2A loss and to test whether accepted core associations are robust outside higher-aneuploidy structure. The signed-direction convention is retained: for direction -1 claims, CDKN2A loss, PTEN loss, or MSI-high positive signed estimates correspond to raw exposed-minus-comparator negative differences and therefore stronger dependency; for direction +1 KEAP1 loss, positive signed estimates correspond to raw positive differences and weaker dependency. The meaningfulness threshold is 0.15 absolute composite dependency-score units in the claimed direction. The PTEN, MSI-high, KEAP1-loss, and SMARCA4-loss comparisons test whether previously accepted effects are concentrated in high-aneuploidy samples or persist below the high-aneuploidy cutoff. Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.

Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.

subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep

the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

- dependency_composite: 0.15 composite dependency-score units

All conclusions remain associations in the supplied composite-dependency dataset only and do not establish causality, single-gene knockout mechanism, or external generalizability.","synthesize":"No assessments are due and no independent validation capacity remains. No validation response deadlines are present. I therefore make no assessment changes, register no further validation, and request no new analyses. The accepted claim set remains the controller-maintained set updated by prior assessments.\n\nThis is the final scientific synthesis for the supplied dataset. It describes unadjusted measured associations only. Direction convention is as registered: for direction +1, a positive signed estimate supports weaker dependency; for direction -1, a positive signed estimate supports stronger dependency. Scientific meaningfulness is defined as 0.15 absolute composite dependency-score units in the claimed direction. The outcome is a composite dependency score, not a single gene knockout phenotype, so none of these findings establish causality, mechanism, single-gene knockout identity, or external generalizability.\n\nSupported findings. Five predictor contrasts are supported by discovery estimates and, for the core contrasts, by supplied independent validation and/or repeated clean-context or subgroup-consistency analyses. KEAP1 loss is associated with weaker dependency: H7/R7 signed +0.8315, 95% interval +0.7658 to +0.8972; independent validation R13 +0.8257, +0.7349 to +0.9165; clean-context H74/R41 +0.8092, +0.7679 to +0.8505; squamous-subtype robustness H281/R234 +0.8771, +0.7625 to +0.9917; high-quality batch_a check H298/R251 +0.8027, +0.6246 to +0.9808. SMARCA4 loss is associated with stronger dependency: H8/R8 signed +0.8325, +0.7667 to +0.8983; independent validation R39 +0.8452, +0.7516 to +0.9389; clean-context H75/R42 +0.8156, +0.7709 to +0.8603; squamous-subtype H282/R235 +0.9887, +0.8614 to +1.1160. TP53 loss is associated with weaker dependency only after correcting the initial direction: H1/R1 original stronger-dependency claim is rejected, while reversed claim H13/R1 signed +0.4232, +0.3268 to +0.5195, with validation R53 +0.3561, +0.2142 to +0.4980; clean-context H68/R44 +0.3949, +0.2911 to +0.4987; squamous-subtype H283/R236 +0.4467, +0.2608 to +0.6325; high-quality batch_a check H300/R253 +0.5235, +0.2904 to +0.7566. MSI-high is associated with stronger dependency: H120/R73 signed +0.7918, +0.6763 to +0.9072, with validation R92 +0.8020, +0.6349 to +0.9691; squamous-subtype H284/R237 +0.9175, +0.6945 to +1.1405; adenocarcinoma H122/R80 +0.7415, +0.6053 to +0.8777; IFN-gamma-high context H158/R143 +0.8113, +0.6772 to +0.9455. PTEN loss is a moderate but supported stronger-dependency association: H37/R24 signed +0.2268, +0.1307 to +0.3229; independent validation R26 +0.2813, +0.1345 to +0.4280; clean-context H70/R43 +0.2521, +0.1693 to +0.3350; MSI-negative clean contexts include H149/R107 +0.2601, +0.1817 to +0.3385 with validation R119 +0.2707, +0.1515 to +0.3900, and H177/R139 +0.2551, +0.1680 to +0.3423 with validation R145 +0.2333, +0.0948 to +0.3718. PTEN is supported overall because of repeated coherent estimates, but it is less precise than KEAP1, SMARCA4, TP53, or MSI-high, and some bounds approach or fall below the 0.15-unit threshold.\n\nNegative findings. Many measured predictors did not support threshold-exceeding associations in this dataset. These include KRAS mutation H2/R2, MYC amplification H3/R3, EGFR amplification H4/R4, PIK3CA mutation H5/R5, STK11 loss H6/R6 and validated clean-context STK11 H18/R79, ARID1A loss H9/R9, RB1 loss H38/R25, ERBB2 amplification H40/R67 and clean-context H102/R68, BRCA2 loss H41/R69 and clean-context H103/R70, NF1 loss H42/R71 and clean-context H104/R72, APC mutation H84/R51, BRAF V600E H85/R52, MTAP loss in clean contexts H63/R37 and H97/R64, constructed research markers D/E/F H10-H12/R10-R12, media-serum contrasts H107/R76, H291/R244, H306/R259, Avana library H24/R77, batch_a versus batch_b H176/R131, batch_b versus batch_c H305/R258, female versus male H290/R243, and adenocarcinoma versus squamous H304/R257. These are non-detections or supported null results under the supplied analyses, not proof that true effects are exactly zero. The original MSI-high weaker-dependency claim H43/R73 was rejected because the observed signed estimate was opposite the claimed direction; the reversed stronger-dependency claim H120 is accepted.\n\nInteraction and context modification. No registered interaction was accepted as robust evidence of effect modification. Interaction estimates either failed to credibly exceed the 0.15-unit threshold, crossed zero, or remained unsupported after independent validation. Examples include SMARCA4-by-lineage H20/R144 signed -0.023, -0.167 to +0.121; TP53-by-SMARCA4 H21/R104 -0.032, -0.260 to +0.196; KEAP1-by-TP53 H80/R47 +0.210, +0.019 to +0.400 but not accepted; PTEN-by-KEAP1 H81/R106 +0.093, -0.257 to +0.442 after validation; PTEN-by-SMARCA4 H82/R49 -0.107, -0.321 to +0.108; PTEN-by-TP53 H83/R50 -0.157, -0.459 to +0.145; MSI-context KEAP1 interaction H132/R85 -0.049, -0.300 to +0.201; MSI-context SMARCA4 interaction H133/R86 -0.181, -0.404 to +0.041; MSI-context TP53 interaction H134/R87 -0.123, -0.563 to +0.316; growth-rate PTEN interaction H259/R212 +0.061, -0.110 to +0.231; and CDKN2A/MSI reciprocal interactions H293/R246 and H296/R249 both -0.084, -0.372 to +0.205. Accepted within-stratum mean differences therefore establish descriptive consistency in those strata, not causal context modification.\n\nUnresolved uncertainty. record.narrative:
Assessed the final newly delivered discovery evidence using the registered signed-direction convention: a positive signed estimate supports the registered direction, with direction -1 corresponding to stronger dependency and direction +1 to weaker dependency. The threshold is 0.15 composite dependency-score units in the claimed direction.

CDKN2A loss remains the principal borderline unresolved signal. H307 (R260) has signed estimate +0.1539, 95% lower +0.0840 to upper +0.2237, in adult clean TP53-, SMARCA4-, KEAP1-, PTEN-, MTAP-intact, MSI-negative cells. The point is barely above threshold and the interval excludes zero, supporting the claimed direction, but the lower bound falls below the 0.15-unit threshold, so threshold-level meaningfulness is not credibly established. H308 (R261) further restricts to lower aneuploidy and has signed estimate +0.1377, 95% +0.0605 to +0.2149; the point is below threshold and the interval remains uncertain, so unresolved.

H309 (R262) tests PTEN loss in lower aneuploidy. The signed estimate is +0.2197, 95% +0.1066 to +0.3329, supporting the claimed stronger-dependency direction and with point estimate above threshold, but the lower bound is below 0.15. This is compatible with the broader supported PTEN-loss association, but the lower-aneuploidy context check itself does not credibly clear the threshold and remains unresolved. H73 (R270), PTEN loss in clean KEAP1/SMARCA4-negative high-screen-quality context, is similar: signed estimate +0.2188, 95% +0.0905 to +0.3472; above threshold point but lower bound below threshold, unresolved.

The lower-aneuploidy core-signal robustness checks support accepted effects. H310 (R263) MSI-high in lower aneuploidy has signed estimate +0.7751, 95% +0.6396 to +0.9107; H311 (R264) KEAP1 loss in MSI-negative lower aneuploidy has signed estimate +0.8350, 95% +0.7620 to +0.9080; H312 (R265) SMARCA4 loss in MSI-negative lower aneuploidy has signed estimate +0.8521, 95% +0.7771 to +0.9271. Each is far above threshold with bounds clear of the threshold, supporting the registered directions and confirming these core signals are not confined to the higher-aneuploidy half. H124 (R271) MSI-high in clean adenocarcinoma context has signed estimate +0.7720, 95% +0.6781 to +0.8660, accepted.

Interaction checks are negative or unsupported. H113 (R266), PTEN-by-aneuploidy interaction, signed estimate +0.0253, 95% -0.1874 to +0.2380, is near null and crosses zero; no credible threshold-level interaction. H115 (R267), TP53-by-mutation_burden interaction, signed estimate +0.1267, 95% -0.0914 to +0.3448, is below threshold and crosses zero; reject as not supporting registered interaction. H117 (R268), KEAP1-by-hypoxia interaction, signed estimate -0.0286, 95% -0.1789 to +0.1217, is opposite to the claimed positive direction; reject. H119 (R269), SMARCA4-by-growth-rate interaction, signed estimate -0.0951, 95% -0.2755 to +0.0853, is opposite to the claimed direction and crosses zero; reject. These rejections indicate no supported effect modification in these supplied-data comparisons, not proof of exact absence.

No validation is requested because no new independent validation capacity remains. The final accepted supplied-data associations remain KEAP1 loss weaker dependency, SMARCA4 loss stronger dependency, TP53 loss weaker dependency after direction correction, MSI-high stronger dependency, and PTEN loss moderate stronger dependency. CDKN2A remains unresolved/borderline; no interaction is accepted as supported. All conclusions are unadjusted associations in the supplied dataset and do not establish causality, mechanism, single-gene knockout identity, or external generalizability.

prompt:
Iteration 25/25, stage synthesize, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- dependency_composite: 0.15 composite dependency-score units

No validation response deadlines are present. I therefore make no assessment changes, register no further validation, and request no new analyses. The accepted claim set remains the controller-maintained set updated by prior assessments.\n\nThis is the final scientific synthesis for the supplied dataset. It describes unadjusted measured associations only. Direction convention is as registered: for direction +1, a positive signed estimate supports weaker dependency; for direction -1, a positive signed estimate supports stronger dependency. Scientific meaningfulness is defined as 0.15 absolute composite dependency-score units in the claimed direction. The outcome is a composite dependency score, not a single gene knockout phenotype, so none of these findings establish causality, mechanism, single-gene knockout identity, or external generalizability.\n\nSupported findings. Five predictor contrasts are supported by discovery estimates and, for the core contrasts, by supplied independent validation and/or repeated clean-context or subgroup-consistency analyses. KEAP1 loss is associated with weaker dependency: H7/R7 signed +0.8315, 95% interval +0.7658 to +0.8972; independent validation R13 +0.8257, +0.7349 to +0.9165; clean-context H74/R41 +0.8092, +0.7679 to +0.8505; squamous-subtype robustness H281/R234 +0.8771, +0.7625 to +0.9917; high-quality batch_a check H298/R251 +0.8027, +0.6246 to +0.9808. SMARCA4 loss is associated with stronger dependency: H8/R8 signed +0.8325, +0.7667 to +0.8983; independent validation R39 +0.8452, +0.7516 to +0.9389; clean-context H75/R42 +0.8156, +0.7709 to +0.8603; squamous-subtype H282/R235 +0.9887, +0.8614 to +1.1160. TP53 loss is associated with weaker dependency only after correcting the initial direction: H1/R1 original stronger-dependency claim is rejected, while reversed claim H13/R1 signed +0.4232, +0.3268 to +0.5195, with validation R53 +0.3561, +0.2142 to +0.4980; clean-context H68/R44 +0.3949, +0.2911 to +0.4987; squamous-subtype H283/R236 +0.4467, +0.2608 to +0.6325; high-quality batch_a check H300/R253 +0.5235, +0.2904 to +0.7566. MSI-high is associated with stronger dependency: H120/R73 signed +0.7918, +0.6763 to +0.9072, with validation R92 +0.8020, +0.6349 to +0.9691; squamous-subtype H284/R237 +0.9175, +0.6945 to +1.1405; adenocarcinoma H122/R80 +0.7415, +0.6053 to +0.8777; IFN-gamma-high context H158/R143 +0.8113, +0.6772 to +0.9455. PTEN loss is a moderate but supported stronger-dependency association: H37/R24 signed +0.2268, +0.1307 to +0.3229; independent validation R26 +0.2813, +0.1345 to +0.4280; clean-context H70/R43 +0.2521, +0.1693 to +0.3350; MSI-negative clean contexts include H149/R107 +0.2601, +0.1817 to +0.3385 with validation R119 +0.2707, +0.1515 to +0.3900, and H177/R139 +0.2551, +0.1680 to +0.3423 with validation R145 +0.2333, +0.0948 to +0.3718. PTEN is supported overall because of repeated coherent estimates, but it is less precise than KEAP1, SMARCA4, TP53, or MSI-high, and some bounds approach or fall below the 0.15-unit threshold.\n\nNegative findings. Many measured predictors did not support threshold-exceeding associations in this dataset. These include KRAS mutation H2/R2, MYC amplification H3/R3, EGFR amplification H4/R4, PIK3CA mutation H5/R5, STK11 loss H6/R6 and validated clean-context STK11 H18/R79, ARID1A loss H9/R9, RB1 loss H38/R25, ERBB2 amplification H40/R67 and clean-context H102/R68, BRCA2 loss H41/R69 and clean-context H103/R70, NF1 loss H42/R71 and clean-context H104/R72, APC mutation H84/R51, BRAF V600E H85/R52, MTAP loss in clean contexts H63/R37 and H97/R64, constructed research markers D/E/F H10-H12/R10-R12, media-serum contrasts H107/R76, H291/R244, H306/R259, Avana library H24/R77, batch_a versus batch_b H176/R131, batch_b versus batch_c H305/R258, female versus male H290/R243, and adenocarcinoma versus squamous H304/R257. These are non-detections or supported null results under the supplied analyses, not proof that true effects are exactly zero. The original MSI-high weaker-dependency claim H43/R73 was rejected because the observed signed estimate was opposite the claimed direction; the reversed stronger-dependency claim H120 is accepted.\n\nInteraction and context modification. No registered interaction was accepted as robust evidence of effect modification. Interaction estimates either failed to credibly exceed the 0.15-unit threshold, crossed zero, or remained unsupported after independent validation. Examples include SMARCA4-by-lineage H20/R144 signed -0.023, -0.167 to +0.121; TP53-by-SMARCA4 H21/R104 -0.032, -0.260 to +0.196; KEAP1-by-TP53 H80/R47 +0.210, +0.019 to +0.400 but not accepted; PTEN-by-KEAP1 H81/R106 +0.093, -0.257 to +0.442 after validation; PTEN-by-SMARCA4 H82/R49 -0.107, -0.321 to +0.108; PTEN-by-TP53 H83/R50 -0.157, -0.459 to +0.145; MSI-context KEAP1 interaction H132/R85 -0.049, -0.300 to +0.201; MSI-context SMARCA4 interaction H133/R86 -0.181, -0.404 to +0.041; MSI-context TP53 interaction H134/R87 -0.123, -0.563 to +0.316; growth-rate PTEN interaction H259/R212 +0.061, -0.110 to +0.231; and CDKN2A/MSI reciprocal interactions H293/R246 and H296/R249 both -0.084, -0.372 to +0.205. Accepted within-stratum mean differences therefore establish descriptive consistency in those strata, not causal context modification.\n\nUnresolved uncertainty. The principal unresolved biological signal is CDKN2A loss. Multiple discovery estimates are near or above the threshold but do not credibly clear it, and the clean-context independent validation falls below threshold: H22/R23 +0.141, +0.062 to +0.220; H78/R45 +0.144, +0.083 to +0.204; H88/R57 +0.164, +0.101 to +0.228, with validation R66 +0.121, +0.034 to +0.209; H96/R63 +0.150, +0.082 to +0.218; H273/R226 +0.172, +0.081 to +0.263; H289/R242 +0.161, +0.069 to +0.254; H297/R250 in TP53-loss cells +0.199, -0.053 to +0.452; and H292/R245 in MSI-high cells +0.074, -0.204 to +0.353. The recent clean high-Cas9 CDKN2A context H301/R254 signed +0.083, -0.045 to +0.212, remains unresolved because the estimate is below threshold and imprecise. The CDKN2A-by-TP53-loss interaction H302/R255 is rejected, signed -0.074, -0.337 to +0.189.
